hint: tap anywhere to throw some shade

game.q: the sun is on his face. a cobra slides out of the grass. what does it do?
opts: borrows his shade to cool off
spreads its hood over his face

wrong.cool: close, but it gave shade instead of taking it.
wrong.nap: relatable. but it stayed up, on duty.

game.right: YES. it spread its hood like a small umbrella. the most dangerous thing in the field became his shelter.

end.line: in an old sakhi, a cobra spread its hood over a sleeping boy, and a neighbor saw who he was.
end.l1: a boy fell asleep in the sun.

cliff.s1: a guru is set free from prison.
cliff.s2: the doors open. he refuses to leave alone.

share: a hot field. a sleeping boy. a cobra. a sakhi on infinite hill
